settings.title: Settings
general.pageBorderHint: A glowing border around the page shows that the agent is working there.
general.keyboardHint: The keyboard shortcut that opens Nanobrowser in the side panel.
models.defaultModelHint: New conversations start with this model. You can change it in the composer.
models.keysNote: Your API keys stay in this browser. They go only to their own provider, never to Nanobrowser or anyone else.
models.apiKeyOptional: API key (if the server needs one)
models.addHint: Click Add to save this model.
models.keyRefused: The provider did not accept this key. Check it and save it again.
models.testOk: Connected. The model called the test tool ({ms} ms).
models.testNoTools: Connected, but the model did not call the test tool. It is marked "no tool calling" and cannot run the agent.
models.fix.lmstudio: LM Studio refused the request. Turn on "Enable CORS" in LM Studio's Developer settings, then try again.
models.fix.generic: The server refused the request or could not be reached. Check the address, and allow requests from browser extensions (CORS) on the server.
models.fix.ollama: Ollama refused the request from the extension. Allow extension origins and restart Ollama:
models.fix.ollama.mac:
launchctl setenv OLLAMA_ORIGINS "chrome-extension://*"
(then quit and reopen Ollama)
models.fix.ollama.windows:
Settings → System → About → Advanced system settings → Environment Variables:
OLLAMA_ORIGINS = chrome-extension://*
(then quit and reopen Ollama)
models.fix.ollama.linux:
sudo systemctl edit ollama.service
[Service]
Environment="OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://*"
sudo systemctl restart ollama
composer.needModel: Nanobrowser needs a model to chat. Connect a model provider and pick a model.
whatsNew.title: What's new in Nanobrowser {version}
whatsNew.v03.layer: A new browser control layer built on Chrome's DevTools Protocol: faster and more reliable on real pages.
whatsNew.v03.agent: A new agent in the style of pi: one simple loop that plans, acts and shows every step.
whatsNew.v03.shortcuts: Shortcuts: type / to run a saved prompt.
whatsNew.v03.moved: Your saved prompts are already there.
rating.title: Enjoying Nanobrowser?
rating.body: Nanobrowser is free and open source. A quick rating on the {store} helps others find it, and your feedback makes it better.
history.title: History
history.heading: Recent tasks
history.description: Your conversations. Open one to read it here; send a message in it to continue it in this tab.
history.busy: Recent tasks opens once this task stops.
card.siteAsks: This site is set to always ask.
card.checkAddress: Check the address before you enter anything.
card.handover.title: Nanobrowser detected a step that is yours
card.handover.grant: Review and grant the access on {site} yourself.
card.handover.secret: Enter your password or code on {site} yourself.
card.handover.then: When you have finished, press Done, and the agent carries on. Press Cancel to stop this step.
card.handover.restarted: If you already did this, press Done.
card.handover.noDialog: Chrome cannot show this dialog to you. Press Cancel to dismiss it.
card.handover.dialogWaiting: The dialog is still waiting. Answer it in the tab, then press Done.
card.takeover.title: Please do this step yourself
card.takeover.secrets: Check the address before you enter a password or a code.
card.input.title: The agent asks:
card.input.noSecrets: Don't type passwords, card numbers or codes here. What you type is sent to the model.
composer.cardWarning: This looks like a card number. What you send here goes to the model provider.
tabs.none: No other tabs in this window.
card.confirm.moveTab: Another conversation is using this tab. Move it here?
scope.blocked: That tab is on a site you blocked, so it was not shared.
scope.gone: That tab is no longer open.
scope.ownerRunning: The other conversation is working in that tab. Stop it first.
history.closeAgentTabs: Also close the {count} tabs the agent opened?
history.closeAgentTab: Also close the tab the agent opened?
panel.newChatRunning: The agent is working in this conversation. Move this tab to a new chat anyway?
run.capped: The agent stopped at its turn limit.
queue.title: Sent when the current action finishes
act.readMore: Read more of the page's text
act.readElement: Read the text of one element
act.observed: Observed {method} {path} during this action; no approval was requested.
agent.defaultModeHint: New conversations start in this mode. You can change it in the composer.
agent.turnCapHint: The most steps the agent takes on one task. When it reaches this number, it stops and asks whether to go on.
perm.neverAllowed: Payments, granting access, and entering passwords, card numbers or codes are always left to you, whatever the setting. The agent may not spot every one, so keep an eye on what it does.
perm.mic.title: Microphone
perm.mic.hint: Allow the microphone to use voice input in the side panel.
perm.mic.grantedHint: You can now use voice input in the side panel.
perm.mic.turnOff: Turn it off in Chrome settings
perm.features.title: Additional browser permissions
perm.features.hint: Let Nanobrowser name its tab groups, notify you and save files.
perm.features.cardHint: Allow these to unlock more features and make Nanobrowser easier to use.
perm.features.welcomeHint: Allow these to unlock more features: tab groups named after the task, notifications, and saving files. You can also do this later in Settings.
perm.features.tabGroupsHint: Lets the agent name its tab group after the task, such as "Book a flight", and mark it when it needs you.
perm.features.notificationsHint: Lets the agent notify you when a task is done or needs you, even when the side panel is closed.
perm.features.filesHint: Lets the agent save the files it creates, such as a table or a report, to your Downloads folder.
perm.sitesHint: Choose how the agent makes changes on a site: submitting, sending, deleting and uploading.
perm.askHint: Changes always ask first, even in Auto mode.
perm.blockHint: The agent never opens or acts on the site.
perm.badSite: That is not a site address.
card.save.title: Save this file?
card.save.where: It is saved in your Downloads folder. A file of the same name is not overwritten.
card.save.askFirst: Chrome asks you first to let Nanobrowser save files.
card.save.refused: Saving needs your permission in Chrome. Press Save to allow it, or Skip.
act.downloaded: The page started downloading «{name}» from {from}. Check in your downloads that it finished.
mic.title: Allow the microphone for voice input
mic.why: Nanobrowser turns what you say into text in the message box. The side panel cannot ask for the microphone itself, so this page asks once.
mic.closing: Done. This page closes, and recording starts in the side panel.
mic.denied: The microphone was not allowed. To change this, open the site settings from the icon left of the address bar, allow the microphone, then try again.
composer.voiceNeedsModel: To talk instead of typing, choose a voice model in Settings.
composer.voiceNoMic: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
composer.voiceBlocked: Nanobrowser can't use the microphone. Allow it in Settings → Permissions.
composer.voiceCannotRecord: Recording could not start. Try again.
composer.voiceNothing: No speech was heard. Try again, a little closer to the microphone.
composer.voiceError: Could not turn speech into text: {error}
voice.title: Voice input
voice.description: Press the mic and talk. Your words show up as text. The audio goes only to the voice model's provider.
voice.modelNeedsKey: Add an OpenAI or Google Gemini provider with its API key below, then choose its voice model here.
voice.languageHint: The language you speak. Choosing it can make the text more accurate.
shortcuts.hint: Save a prompt here. Type / in the side panel to use it.
shortcut.name: Name
shortcut.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. You type /{name} to start it.
shortcut.textHint: Sent as your message when you start the shortcut.
shortcut.error.name: A name uses lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters.
shortcut.error.url: The start page must be a web address (https://…).
shortcut.blocked: The shortcut's start page is on a site you blocked. Nothing was sent.
panel.starter.starText: Open https://github.com/nanobrowser/nanobrowser. If I'm signed in and haven't starred it yet, star it. If I'm not signed in, stop and tell me.
panel.starter.summarizeText: Summarize this page in a few bullet points.
panel.starter.newsText: Go to news.ycombinator.com and list the top 5 stories, each with a one-line summary of what the linked article says.
launcher.label: Shortcuts and commands
agent.instructionsHint: What the agent should know in every conversation, for example "My company is Acme GmbH. Answer briefly." Only you can change this; the agent cannot.
tips.title: Tips
tips.intro: Three tips to use Nanobrowser safely.
tips.familiar.title: Start with sites you know
tips.familiar.body: Try it first on websites you use often. Watch what it does, and press Stop at any time.
tips.profile.title: Use a separate profile
tips.profile.body: Give Nanobrowser its own browser profile without your sensitive data.
tips.avoid.title: Skip risky tasks
tips.avoid.body: Avoid payments, private data and websites you don't trust. Some pages try to trick AI.
welcome.helpHint: Send us anonymous usage data, such as how many tasks worked and which features you used. Never your conversations.
welcome.title: Welcome to Nanobrowser
welcome.intro: Nanobrowser is an AI agent that works in your browser. Tell it what you want, and it reads pages, clicks and types for you.
welcome.example.summary: Summarize a page or a long article
welcome.example.form: Fill in a form with the details you give it
welcome.example.research: Search several sites and put what it finds in a table
welcome.pin.title: Pin Nanobrowser to the toolbar
welcome.pin.body: Click {extensions} at the top right, then {pin} next to Nanobrowser.
welcome.model.intro: Pick a model: run one on your computer, or use a provider with your API key.
welcome.model.localHint: Ollama or LM Studio on this computer. Nothing leaves your machine.
welcome.model.cloudHint: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or OpenRouter, with your API key.
welcome.model.ready: {model} works and is now your default model.
welcome.model.noTools: {model} answered but did not call the test tool, so it cannot run the agent. Choose another model.
welcome.model.small: This model has a {tokens}-token context window. 16k or more is recommended: set a larger context in the server.
welcome.model.smallUnknown: Load the model with a context window of 16k tokens or more.
welcome.model.noneListed: The server lists no models. Download one first, for example with "ollama pull".
language.uiHint: Choose the display language for Nanobrowser.
language.responseHint: The language the agent replies in.
attach.refused.document: {name}: PDF and Office files cannot be read in this version. Copy the text into a text file, or paste it.
attach.refused.type: {name}: only images (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) and text files can be attached.
composer.autoNotice: In Auto mode, the agent submits, sends, deletes and uploads without asking you first. It still leaves payments and passwords to you, but may not spot every one.
data.usageLine: Nanobrowser's data in this browser takes up {used}.
data.conversationsHint: To delete one conversation, use Recent tasks in the side panel.
data.everythingHint: Deletes all conversations, attached files and run records, your shortcuts, your site rules, your settings, and your models with their API keys. It also deletes the conversations the previous version left. Running tasks stop first. This cannot be undone. Your Privacy choices stay as they are.
data.previousHint: {count} conversations from Nanobrowser v0.2. This version can't open them. Export them as Markdown to keep them.
data.previousHintOne: {count} conversation from Nanobrowser v0.2. This version can't open it. Export it as Markdown to keep it.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.pingHint: Send a short note on days you use Nanobrowser, so we know how many people use it.
privacy.statsHint: Send us anonymous usage data, such as how many tasks worked and which features you used. Never your conversations.
about.license: Nanobrowser is open source under the {license} licence.
card.input.sendAgain: Press Send again to send it anyway.
composer.reasoningNextRun: Applies when the next run starts
notice.reasoningDropped: This model did not take the reasoning setting; continuing without it.
notice.imagesDropped: This model did not take images; continuing without them.
notice.stopped: Stopped · What should Nanobrowser do instead?
